mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_FRMDRAW_M ( UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_ID, DOC_UNQ_ID, DOC_TYP, DOC_PART_CD, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(UNQ_KY_VAL), 0)+1 FROM GE_MP_FRMDRAW_M), #{FRM_ID}, #{DOC_UNQ_ID}, #{DOC_TYP}, #{DOC_PART_CD}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )
